entities.summary: Stephen Paget was an English surgeon and pro-vivisection campaigner. On the basis of the works of Fuchs, he proposed the "seed and soil" theory of metastasis, which claims the distribution of cancers are not coincidental. He was the son of the distinguished surgeon and pathologist Sir James Paget.
